name: Quick Enrich
summary: Work email and phone lookup by LinkedIn URL or name and company, reverse email lookup, domain and contact discovery, and company search.

api_key.description: a Quick Enrich API key (the docs say to contact support to get one)

notes: Rate limits per API key: 1,000 per minute for search, phone and email lookups; 300 for domain search; 120 for contact and company finders; 6,000 for GTM Unlimited.

Credits: person lookups use one credit only when an email or phone comes back; contact finder search is free; company finder costs 1 credit per company returned; domain search by title costs 1 credit per employee on the page with an email or phone, flat 1 without a title.

Bulk find and verify (submit and status) is only for the GTM Unlimited plan. Flow: quickenrich.bulk.submit returns data.task_id, then poll quickenrich.bulk.status until data.status is completed or failed; completed results are paged with page and per_page.

Finder filters take {include: [...], exclude: [...]} objects. Some fields (country_code, region_code, industry, number_of_employees, revenue, services) need exact values from the public /api/lookups/* endpoints, otherwise 422. Use region_code abbreviations, not full state names.
Paging past 10,000 rows: send the previous meta.next_cursor as cursor; page is then ignored.

endpoints.name: Find a person's email and profile
endpoints.summary: Email, phone, title, LinkedIn and company details for one person.
notes: Give linkedin_url, or company_url with first_name and last_name; with all four it tries LinkedIn first. The response carries email_verification_date.

endpoints.name: Find a person's phone number
endpoints.summary: Phone for one person, by the same inputs as quickenrich.person.enrich.
notes: Give linkedin_url, or company_url with first_name and last_name. One credit only when a phone is returned.

endpoints.name: Reverse email lookup
endpoints.summary: The best matching employee record for one email address.

email.description: Email address to look up (exact match).

notes: One credit only when a match is found.

endpoints.name: Search contacts by company URL and title
endpoints.summary: Up to 20 contacts per page at a company, optionally by title.

title.description: A title or comma-separated titles; matches any.

has_email.description: Only contacts with an email in the database.

endpoints.name: Find contacts by company and person filters
endpoints.summary: Discovery search that returns contacts without email or phone values, flagging has_email and has_phone.

company_url.description: Company websites or domains; open text. {include: [...], exclude: [...]}.

country_code.description: ISO 2-letter company countries; exact values. {include: [...], exclude: [...]}.

region_code.description: Company state abbreviations; exact values. {include: [...], exclude: [...]}.

industry_linkedin.description: Company industries; exact values from /api/lookups/industries. {include: [...], exclude: [...]}.

number_of_employees.description: Employee range labels; exact values. {include: [...], exclude: [...]}.

revenue.description: Revenue range labels; exact values. {include: [...], exclude: [...]}.

bio_li.description: Words in the company LinkedIn About text; open text. {include: [...], exclude: [...]}.

services.description: Company services; exact values from /api/lookups/company-services. {include: [...], exclude: [...]}.

has_email.description: Only contacts that already have an email.

has_phone.description: Only contacts that already have a phone.

page.description: Page number (default 1); only the first 10,000 rows are reachable by page.

cursor.description: Opaque meta.next_cursor from the previous page; echo it unchanged. Overrides page.

notes: A read over POST. Free search (credits_used 0). At least one filter is required. Enrich a hit with quickenrich.person.enrich or quickenrich.phone.find using its employee_linkedin.

endpoints.name: Find companies
endpoints.summary: Companies by website text, LinkedIn description, services, industry, size, revenue and location.

home_page_text.description: Words in scraped website copy; open text. {include: [...], exclude: [...]}.

bio_li.description: Words in the company LinkedIn About text; open text. {include: [...], exclude: [...]}.

number_of_employees.description: Employee range labels; exact values. {include: [...], exclude: [...]}.

revenue.description: Revenue range labels; exact values. {include: [...], exclude: [...]}.

company_url.description: One domain or URL (no include/exclude lists).

include_full_text.description: Also return full home_page_text (default false: snippet only).

page.description: Page number (default 1); only the first 10,000 rows are reachable by page.

cursor.description: Opaque meta.next_cursor from the previous page; echo it unchanged. Overrides page.

notes: A read over POST. 1 credit per company returned, waived with a WebApp Unlimited plan. At least one filter is required.

endpoints.name: Start a bulk find and verify task
endpoints.summary: Finds and verifies emails for up to 10,000 people; the lookup runs after the call returns.

people.description: 1 to 10,000 objects; each needs linkedin_url, or first_name, last_name and company_url.

reverify.description: Default false returns cached emails; true reverifies every stored email.

include_risky.description: Default false. Used only when reverify is true: also return risky and unknown emails.

notes: A read over POST: it starts a job that only produces data. GTM Unlimited plan only; 5 tasks may run at once. Returns data.task_id; poll quickenrich.bulk.status.

endpoints.name: Get a bulk task's status and results
endpoints.summary: Task status (pending, completed, failed) and, once completed, the rows as JSON.

page.description: Page of results (default 1); used once completed.

notes: GTM Unlimited plan only. One credit per real email in the finished result; a failed task uses none.
